evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: excited to shape a fast-moving analytics stack
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Mixed: two speed signals — 'high-growth environments' and 'a fast-moving analytics stack' — sit alongside a single quality bullet, 'Identify and resolve data quality and pipeline issues, ensuring a reliable analytics foundation'.
evidence.domain_risk: Own the core models, transformations, and analytics products that drive track and catalog pricing decisions
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High: the models the role owns set the price Duetti pays to acquire catalogs, and Finance is a named partner for 'revenue drivers, and portfolio health' against '$635 million in capital'.
evidence.collaboration_width: Finance & Management; Data Science; Product; senior engineers; music-industry veterans
evidence.data_team_maturity: We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to join as an early member of our Data Team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: a Data Team, a Head of Data & Analytics and data scientists already exist, but the hire is framed as 'an early member of our Data Team' who will 'help define the future of our data products'.
evidence.jd_authorship: Dive deep into streaming performance and catalog behavior to uncover optimization opportunities for acquired catalogs
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: some bullets are anchored to the actual business problem ('track and catalog pricing decisions', 'streaming performance'), while others are generic partnering boilerplate ('Work closely with Product to design internal tools, workflows').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Finance & Management to uncover insights into catalog performance, revenue drivers, and portfolio health
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed: Finance, Data Science and Product each get a dedicated responsibility bullet of comparable weight, with no single audience named as primary.
evidence.autonomy_level: This role sits at the intersection of analytics, engineering, and product with high autonomy, technical ownership, and direct business impact.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic: the overview grants 'high autonomy, technical ownership' and says the hire will 'help define the future of our data products', with 'Own the core models' leading the responsibilities.
evidence.ai_role: Explore and build LLM-powered internal tools that automate data workflows
evidence.ai_role_explanation: ai_enabler: building LLM-powered internal tooling is a stated responsibility, so the candidate's output is what the AI runs on rather than AI being a personal productivity aid.
evidence.testing_framing: Identify and resolve data quality and pipeline issues, ensuring a reliable analytics foundation across teams
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: data quality appears as a responsibility bullet with ownership verbs ('Identify and resolve', 'ensuring'), not as a tool in the requirements list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensuring a reliable analytics foundation across teams
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: reliability appears once, as one bullet among seven, in a JD otherwise framed around building pricing models and uncovering opportunity.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: help build the systems that power artist sourcing, track pricing, portfolio management, and catalog growth
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Greenfield: build-and-own verbs dominate — 'help build the systems', 'Own the core models', 'Explore and build LLM-powered internal tools' — with only one remediation bullet.
evidence.work_arrangement: Duetti offers a competitive benefits package, including healthcare coverage, flexible paid time off, and a hybrid work model.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is limited to one operational bullet: 'Identify and resolve data quality and pipeline issues, ensuring a reliable analytics foundation across teams.'
